quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Cautious"? (checking both ways before crossing vs. dashing across without looking)
quests.question: Cautious
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what a crossing guard teaches you to do at every corner. That describes the exact opposite of "Cautious"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: cautious means careful to avoid danger, and reckless means careless about danger — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Here's a cool fact: reckless is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Construct"? (cranes stacking beams to build a tower vs. a wrecking ball knocking an old wall down)
quests.question: Construct
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what workers do with cranes and bricks on a busy building site. That describes the exact opposite of "Construct"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: construct means to build something new, and demolish means to knock something old down — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A powerful hurricane can demolish entire wooden houses in minutes.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Genuine"? (a real polished diamond vs. a sparkly piece of plastic)
quests.question: Genuine
quests.hint: Think about how a jeweler checks whether a gem is truly precious. What's the opposite of "Genuine"?
quests.explanation: "Genuine" means truly authentic, not an imitation. "Fake" means made to look authentic, but isn't. Since those are completely different, Fake is the opposite of Genuine!
quests.funFact: A fake smile does not crinkle the corners of your eyes.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Simple"? (a four-piece toddler puzzle vs. a thousand-piece galaxy puzzle)
quests.question: Simple
quests.hint: Here's a clue: which recipe has three steps and which one has thirty. That describes the exact opposite of "Simple"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: simple means easy to understand, with few parts, and complicated means hard to understand, with many parts — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Here's a cool fact: complicated is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Native"? (a language spoken at home since birth vs. a brand-new language learned at school)
quests.question: Native
quests.hint: Here's a clue: the language your family speaks at home, before you learn any others. That describes the exact opposite of "Native"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: native means belonging naturally to a place, and foreign means coming from another place — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Traveling to a foreign country requires you to carry a special passport.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Ordinary"? (a plain Tuesday at school vs. your very own birthday party)
quests.question: Ordinary
quests.hint: Here's a clue: how your birthday feels compared to a regular Wednesday. That describes the exact opposite of "Ordinary"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: ordinary means normal, just like any other day, and special means unusual and important, unlike other days — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A diamond is special because it is the hardest natural rock on Earth.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Attach"? (clipping two papers snugly together vs. pulling the clip back off)
quests.question: Attach
quests.hint: Think about what a paperclip does to hold two pages as one. What's the opposite of "Attach"?
quests.explanation: "Attach" means to fix one thing onto another. "Detach" means to remove one thing from another. Since those are completely different, Detach is the opposite of Attach!
quests.funFact: A lizard can actually detach its tail completely to escape from a predator.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Borrow"? (checking a library book out for two weeks vs. handing your own book to a friend)
quests.question: Borrow
quests.hint: Think about what you do at the library when you want to read a book at home. What's the opposite of "Borrow"?
quests.explanation: "Borrow" means to take something and promise to return it. "Lend" means to let someone use something of yours for a while. Since those are completely different, Lend is the opposite of Borrow!
quests.funFact: Libraries lend out thousands of amazing books to people completely for free.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Expand"? (a balloon growing bigger with every breath vs. a popped balloon crumpling small)
quests.question: Expand
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what a balloon does as you blow more air inside it. That describes the exact opposite of "Expand"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: expand means to grow larger in size, and shrink means to become smaller in size — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A cold glass of water makes the ice cubes slowly shrink and melt.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Gather"? (raking fallen leaves into one big pile vs. wind blowing them all over the yard)
quests.question: Gather
quests.hint: Think about what a gust of wind does to a neat pile of leaves. What's the opposite of "Gather"?
quests.explanation: "Gather" means to bring things together in one place. "Scatter" means to spread things out in many directions. Since those are completely different, Scatter is the opposite of Gather!
quests.funFact: A strong gust of wind will quickly scatter dry leaves all over the yard.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Energetic"? (a puppy zooming around the yard vs. a puppy collapsed in its bed)
quests.question: Energetic
quests.hint: Think about how you feel after recess compared to right before bedtime. What's the opposite of "Energetic"?
quests.explanation: "Energetic" means full of pep and ready to move. "Tired" means worn out and needing rest. Since those are completely different, Tired is the opposite of Energetic!
quests.funFact: Your brain makes you yawn when it is incredibly tired and needs rest.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Abundant"? (a farm field overflowing with wheat vs. a dry patch with only a few stalks)
quests.question: Abundant
quests.hint: Here's a clue: how much water there is in a rainforest compared to a desert. That describes the exact opposite of "Abundant"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: abundant means plentiful, with a lot available, and scarce means rare, with very little available — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Here's a cool fact: scarce is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Punctual"? (walking through the door right as the bell rings vs. rushing in after the bell)
quests.question: Punctual
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what you'd call showing up exactly when the movie starts, not after. That describes the exact opposite of "Punctual"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: punctual means arriving right on time, and late means arriving after the expected time — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Did you know? being late means arriving after the expected or planned time.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Genuine"? (a real polished diamond vs. a sparkly piece of plastic)
quests.question: Genuine
quests.hint: Here's a clue: how a jeweler checks whether a gem is truly precious. That describes the exact opposite of "Genuine"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: genuine means truly authentic, not an imitation, and fake means made to look authentic, but isn't — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a fake diamond is usually just a piece of completely clear glass.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Increase"? (a stack of coins growing taller vs. the same stack shrinking down)
quests.question: Increase
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what happens to your savings jar every time you add a coin. That describes the exact opposite of "Increase"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: increase means to become larger in amount, and decrease means to become smaller in amount — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Applying the brakes will rapidly decrease the speed of a moving car.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Permanent"? (a marker drawing that never washes off vs. chalk that rinses away in the rain)
quests.question: Permanent
quests.hint: Here's a clue: the kind of marker you would never want to use on a school wall. That describes the exact opposite of "Permanent"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: permanent means lasting forever, without changing, and temporary means lasting only a short while — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A temporary bridge is built quickly to bypass a flooded road.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Save"? (dropping coins into a piggy bank vs. letting a faucet run with no one there)
quests.question: Save
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what a piggy bank helps you do with your allowance. That describes the exact opposite of "Save"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: save means to keep something for later instead of using it up, and waste means to use something up without a good reason — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A landfill is a massive area where cities bury all their garbage and waste.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Ancient"? (a crumbling old stone temple vs. a shiny glass skyscraper)
quests.question: Ancient
quests.hint: Here's a clue: which building would have a smartphone charger inside it. That describes the exact opposite of "Ancient"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: ancient means built a very long time ago, and modern means built recently, using the newest ideas — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Modern architecture uses a lot of clean glass and shiny steel.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Visible"? (a rainbow stretched clearly across the sky vs. air you cannot see at all)
quests.question: Visible
quests.hint: Here's a clue: whether you can actually see the air you're breathing. That describes the exact opposite of "Visible"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: visible means able to be seen, and invisible means not able to be seen — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Invisible ink can only be read if you heat the paper or use a special light.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Fiction"? (a storybook about a talking dragon vs. a book packed with real facts about dinosaurs)
quests.question: Fiction
quests.hint: Here's a clue: which shelf at the library holds books about real ocean animals. That describes the exact opposite of "Fiction"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: fiction means a made-up story from someone's imagination, and nonfiction means true information about the real world — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A biography of a famous president is a nonfiction book.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Borrow"? (checking a library book out for two weeks vs. handing your own book to a friend)
quests.question: Borrow
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what you do at the library when you want to read a book at home. That describes the exact opposite of "Borrow"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: borrow means to take something and promise to return it, and lend means to let someone use something of yours for a while — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: If you lend a pencil to a friend, you expect them to give it back later.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Transparent"? (a clean glass window you can see straight through vs. a solid brick wall)
quests.question: Transparent
quests.hint: Here's a clue: which material lets sunlight pass straight into a room. That describes the exact opposite of "Transparent"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: transparent means clear enough to see through, and opaque means solid, so you cannot see through it — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A brick wall is completely opaque, so you cannot see through it at all.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Arrive"? (a plane landing and taxiing to the gate vs. a plane lifting off the runway)
quests.question: Arrive
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what happens the moment a train finally pulls into the station. That describes the exact opposite of "Arrive"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: arrive means to reach a place, and depart means to leave a place — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Migrating birds depart for warmer climates just before the freezing winter.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Gather"? (raking fallen leaves into one big pile vs. wind blowing them all over the yard)
quests.question: Gather
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what a gust of wind does to a neat pile of leaves. That describes the exact opposite of "Gather"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: gather means to bring things together in one place, and scatter means to spread things out in many directions — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A flock of birds will instantly scatter in the sky if a hawk attacks them.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Interior"? (the cozy inside of a house vs. the painted outside walls)
quests.question: Interior
quests.hint: Here's a clue: which part of a house you'd paint to change how it looks from the street. That describes the exact opposite of "Interior"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: interior means the part on the inside of something, and exterior means the part on the outside of something — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A turtle's shell is a hard, bony exterior that protects its soft body.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Fragile"? (an eggshell that cracks at the lightest tap vs. a steel beam that barely bends)
quests.question: Fragile
quests.hint: Here's a clue: which package would need a 'handle with care' sticker. That describes the exact opposite of "Fragile"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: fragile means delicate and easy to break, and sturdy means strong and hard to break — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: An oak tree has an incredibly sturdy trunk that resists strong winds.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Attach"? (clipping two papers snugly together vs. pulling the clip back off)
quests.question: Attach
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what a paperclip does to hold two pages as one. That describes the exact opposite of "Attach"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: attach means to fix one thing onto another, and detach means to remove one thing from another — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: You have to detach a trailer from a truck before you can park it in a garage.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Energetic"? (a puppy zooming around the yard vs. a puppy collapsed in its bed)
quests.question: Energetic
quests.hint: Here's a clue: how you feel after recess compared to right before bedtime. That describes the exact opposite of "Energetic"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: energetic means full of pep and ready to move, and tired means worn out and needing rest — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Muscles feel very heavy and tired after you run a long, fast race.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Humble"? (quietly saying 'we all worked hard' vs. boasting loudly about winning alone)
quests.question: Humble
quests.hint: Here's a clue: how a kind champion often talks about their teammates after winning. That describes the exact opposite of "Humble"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: humble means modest, not boasting about yourself, and proud means feeling very pleased with your own achievement — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: You feel incredibly proud when you finish a very difficult project.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Connect"? (plugging a charger snugly into an outlet vs. yanking the cord back out)
quests.question: Connect
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what you do to your headphones before you can listen to music. That describes the exact opposite of "Connect"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: connect means to join two things together, and disconnect means to pull two things apart — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A storm can disconnect the power lines and cause a dark blackout.
